status: experimental diagnostic only; FreeCAD-9zt remains open

tested_domain.analysis: single-step linear static, mechanical, global coordinates
tested_domain.loads: uniform GRAV on a 10mm cube, native consistent element RHS
tested_domain.supports: one fully prescribed whole-solid or planar-face RBE
tested_domain.observer_tolerance: 1% relative norm for both force and origin moment; no exactness prerequisite

semantics.internal: native stress/shape-gradient integration before resultsforc MPC force transfer
semantics.external: actual native consistent element RHS and point loads retained during mafillsm assembly, before active-DOF filtering
semantics.projection: both vectors projected through the solver's decascaded MPC coefficients; dependent contributions are not re-added
semantics.residual: projected internal minus projected external, selected prescribed degrees of freedom only
semantics.support_identity: observer selects the exact stock-deck REF NODE and ROT NODE; do not sum all SPC rows, which also include internal auxiliary nodes
semantics.force_frame: global Cartesian, native model units (FreeCAD benchmark N)
semantics.rotation_port: generalized couple about the RBE reference point for the tested zero-rotation linear domain
semantics.global_origin_moment: reference couple + reference position cross reference force (FreeCAD benchmark Nmm)
semantics.RF: unmodified standard channel; never relabel this diagnostic as standard RF

not_established: multiple, shared or partially free support ports
applied pressure or concentrated load qualification (code retention is not qualification)
deformable-cut resultants and arbitrary force/moment components
contact force ownership, master application point and moment transfer
finite rotations and nonlinear residual conventions
production keyword, parser, importer, UI and solver deployment

section_contract_unchanged.SOF_SOM: recovered/extrapolated/averaged stress surface integration; not a residual-conservative reaction channel
section_contract_unchanged.CF: native contact forces; native moments use deformed slave application positions
section_contract_unchanged.master_moment: not established by simply negating the slave moment
section_contract_unchanged.free_body_statics: conditionally admissible only after complete body/load/frame/point accounting and independent accuracy qualification

original_R42_acceptance.status: FAIL, unchanged; no original replay or new engineering acceptance
